subject: MAP: evidence ladder, exit gates & acceptance tests (draft)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Liam Murphy <liam@healthscope.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: evidence ladder, exit gates & acceptance tests (draft)

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Per our conversation I attached a first-pass MAP that focuses on three things we heard you care about: measurable success criteria, concrete exit gates, and discrete acceptance tests you can run during the 6-week evaluation. The goal is to make go/no-go decisions deterministic and handoff-friendly.

High-level ask: Can you please review the "Success Evidence Ladder" tab and confirm the acceptance thresholds for the top two KPIs (extraction accuracy and end-to-end latency) by EOD Wednesday so we can lock the pilot runbook? Specific asks are inline in the sheet.

Key timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): finalize success thresholds and security checklist signoff
- Weeks 1–4: pilot/test runs; run the 3 acceptance vignettes in week 3
- Week 5: performance regression sweep and SLA sampling
- Week 6: decision window (greenlight / remediation / stop)

Exit gates we proposed (examples)
- Gate 1 (Data readiness): >=90% of sample mappings available + sanitized test bundle uploaded
- Gate 2 (Quality): extraction F1 >= 0.88 on canonical dataset for three consecutive runs
- Gate 3 (Reliability): p95 inference latency <= 180ms across production-like load tests

Attachments included: MAP_HealthScope_v1.xlsx (MAP + acceptance test definitions), redwood-security-qa.pdf (SOC2 highlights + evidence pointers).

Next steps from our side:
- Monica: draft the smoke test harness and sample vignettes (see sheet)
- Jordan: prepare the SLA sampling plan and a short runbook for the week-5 regression sweep

If that timeline looks tight for procurement, let me know what buffer you need and we’ll shift accordingly.

Thanks —
Sean 
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP: evidence ladder, exit gates & acceptance tests (draft)

Sean —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the concrete framing. A few quick notes after a first pass:

1) Timeline: procurement is tight the week of Aug 2. We need to complete internal security review before scheduling any production-like load tests. Can we push the regression sweep and decision window one week later?

2) KPIs: On extraction F1, our tolerance for critical fields is higher — can you break the F1 by field type (ID, DOB, numeric results) so we can validate the risk surface?

3) Acceptance tests: The three vignettes look good, can you add an explicit oracle for ambiguous cases (who adjudicates?) and point to the expected evidence artifact (CSV of mismatches + redwood logs)?

Procurement will need an itemized mutual action plan and the contract draft before finance can issue PO. I’m looping procurement so they have visibility.

Liam
Liam Murphy
Head of Data Integrations, HealthScope Medical
liam@healthscope.com

Liam / Team —

Thanks for the feedback. I’ve attached an updated MAP and a short runbook that reflects the revised timeline (regression window moved +7 days). Highlights:

- Per-field KPI breakdown added under "Success Evidence": ID (F1 >= 0.95), DOB (F1 >= 0.98), numeric_results (F1 >= 0.90), free_text (F1 >= 0.82 with manual sampling).
- Adjudication: HealthScope will nominate two reviewers; Redwood will provide a neutral adjudicator for tie-breaks and maintain the mismatch CSV for audit. Procedure is in the runbook.
- Regression sweep plan: week 5 -> now week 6. SLA sampling script included (simple python snippet and seed = 42).

Attachments: MAP_HealthScope_v1.xlsx (v1.1), redwood-security-qa.pdf, DocuSign link to the MAP-confirmation stub (we use this to attach MAP as an exhibit to the SOW).
